docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Krishna Sastri’s handbook of the bronze and stone images of the Hindu gods and goddesses of the south, with the iconographic rules of the Āgamas and the Śilpa texts (Madras, 1916). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in Cornell University Library; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: South-indian images of gods and goddesses · Krishna Sastri, H. (Hosakote) · 1916, 316 scanned pages. Published 1916; Hosakote Krishna Sastri died 1928; public domain in India.

The scans of this book are not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page was read from the scan by machine (OCR) for this library, and lightly cleaned; it may contain errors, and the scan of every page is one button away.
